crossRefs.note: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,
translations.bsb: So the men Moses had sent to spy out the land, who had returned and made the whole congregation grumble against him by bringing out a bad report about the land—
translations.kjv: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
translations.asv: And the men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report against the land,
